decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development, by reason of the excessive number of solar panels, their&nbsp;prominent siting on the front roofslope and the extent of the roof covered, would have a detrimental impact on the character and appearance of the existing dwelling, streetscene and&nbsp;the Pinner Hill Conservation Area. There are no public benefits identified that would overcome the less than substantial harm to the designated heritage assets. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the relevant provisions of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1, DM6 and DM7 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the Pinner Hill Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy (2009).</p>

<p>The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of its scale (dimensions/mass) in combination with historic additions and cumulative impacts would result in disproportionate additions over and above the size of the original building forming inappropriate development within the Metropolitan Green Belt.&nbsp; There are no very special circumstances that clearly outweigh the harm caused on the Metropolitan Green Belt by reason of inappropriateness and the impact on the openness and the character of the area. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the relevant provisions of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policies G2 of the London Plan (2021), CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and DM16 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>
description: Integration and enclosure of open veranda to front to create increased internal floor space, Photovoltaic solar panels to front roof slopes (Demolition of ground floor front bay window)
